description:
FILED s450t (Opus, agent T of round 8), found finishing #561.  PRE-EXISTING
and nothing to do with #561/#602 -- it is a term-grammar gap.

REPRO (no eval needed):
    our %h = (k => 'v');
    my $x = *h{HASH}{k};
    print "1=[", (defined $x ? $x : 'U'), "]\n";
  perl: 1=[v]
  PCL:  PCL: statement dropped ... -- Bug. Fell through. Missing case:
        [glob_slot(HASH), 'Structure::Block<{k}>']
        then the run DIES at the drop site (post-flip).

`*h{HASH}` alone works and returns the hash ref; what is missing is the
postfix chain CONTINUING through a glob_slot node.  The array twin
`*a{ARRAY}[0]` is presumably the same shape (not probed).

WHERE IT BITES: t/re/reg_namedcapture.t test 1 is
    *X = *-;  'X'=~/(?<X>X)/;  print eval '*X{HASH}{X} || 1' ? ...
so the file is 1 ok / 1 notok after #561 (was 0/2); this drop is the whole
remaining row.  The drop happens inside a STRING EVAL there, so it surfaces
as a trapped die rather than a transpile-time census entry.

RELATED, and needed for the same row to pass on VALUE as well as on shape:
task #672 (%- values must be ARRAYREFS).
subject: A SUBSCRIPT on a glob-slot access is a DROP: `*h{HASH}{k}` / `*X{HASH}{X}` dies "Missing case: glob_slot" (t/re/reg_namedcapture.t test 1 sits on it)
